reason: Kernel Foundry is an LLM-guided evolutionary system for generating and optimizing Triton kernels and reports speedups on KernelBench. It improves generated kernel execution, but the evaluated target is generic kernel tasks rather than LLM model inference kernels or an LLM serving stack; the linked inference-systems lineage leaves a plausible, limited compiler connection.
title: Kernel Foundry: A Diagnosis-driven Evolutionary Kernel Optimizer with Multi-Experts
